thread:
Anya (Design): dropping a mini-toolbar exploration for the p95 + heatmap card. Goal: keep the metric readable at narrow widths and add three lightweight controls: timeframe, sampling indicator, and quick-copy. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/jkl012/mini-toolbar

Anya (Design): question: should the sampling indicator be an always-visible microbadge (e.g., "1/10") or an icon that reveals the rate on hover? thinking discoverability vs compactness.

Marco (Eng): microbadge wins for discoverability. Icon-only hides state and we then need extra fetches to show current rate. Badge is just text and cheap.

Priya (PM): ops asked for copy-to-clipboard to be one-tap. If we put it behind a menu it's friction. Could be a tiny icon on the right with tooltip "Copy visible window as CSV".

Sam (A11y): accessibility notes: whichever control order we pick, keyboard order must match visual order. For icon-only affordances, ensure aria-label includes context: "Sampling: 1 in 10". Also toasts need aria-live polite and not steal focus.

Anya (Design): ok badge + copy-on-right default. for pinned cards we can surface an expanded copy label "Copy visible timeframe". Tooltip wording per Sam: explicit and includes row limit (10k).

Marco (Eng): implementation plan: badge element with role=status and aria-live=polite so assistive tech reads sampling changes. Copy uses navigator.clipboard.writeText(csv) + non-modal toast via deploy-bot. Add 5s client throttle.

Priya (PM): tweak microcopy: replace "Auto-sample" with "Adaptive sampling" everywhere. And add analytics events: mini_copy_clicked and sampling_badge_toggled with sampling_rate tag.

Sam (A11y): also request: heatmap legend use pattern overlays in addition to color, and ensure the p95 tooltip includes aria-describedby that points to an offscreen label (e.g., "p95 value 240ms").

Anya (Design): will update assets with badge states (default/hover/focus), full tooltip strings, and pattern legend mock. will include a small a11y checklist in the spec.

deploy-bot: Assets uploaded to staging/mini-toolbar/ (build 2026-03-25T10:04Z)

Marco (Eng): sounds good. we'll feature-flag the change for a gradual rollout and add the events Priya requested.

Anya (Design): thanks all, pinging when figma is updated. end."
